deadline.value: Apply by August 15, 2027 for September 2027 entry. Processing takes 6-8 weeks and a study permit takes longer, so apply by mid-June.
deadline.quote: International Application Deadlines September start - Apply by August 15, 2027 | Please note that processing graduate applications can take approximately 6-8 weeks. | International students will need extra lead time due to processing of student permits.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the program page.

supervisor.value: You need a faculty member's agreement to be your thesis advisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: Prior to applying, applicants need to obtain the support of a faculty member willing to serve as their thesis advisor.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are guaranteed at least CAD 20,500 a year for 4 years, plus a half TA in the first two years.
funding.quote: All MSc and PhD full-time students will receive funding while registered full-time in their eligible semesters which is 6 semesters for MSc and 12 semesters for PhD with satisfactory progress in each semester. | PhD students will be guaranteed minimum funding of $20,500 per year for 4 years (12 semesters).

entry_route.value: A related MSc with an A- (80%) average is generally required; direct entry from a BSc only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the PhD program is generally restricted to students with a recognized MSc degree in a related field obtained with a minimum academic standing of “A-“ (≥80%) in their postgraduate studies. | In exceptional cases, students may enter the PhD program directly from a BSc (Hons)

notes: Three focus areas: Earth and Atmospheric Science, Ecosystem Science and Biodiversity, and Plant and Environmental Health.
name: PhD in Environmental Sciences
